extracted.name: Spiced ginger beer slow cooker cabbage
extracted.description: Enjoy this spiced ginger beer slow cooker cabbage at Christmastime. With sweetness and spice, it makes an ideal accompaniment to a roasted ham
ingredient_lines: 2 large eating apples each sliced into six wedges
thumb-sized piece of ginger peeled and finely grated
½ tbsp light brown soft sugar
instruction_lines: Heat the slow cooker to low. Put all the ingredients in the slow cooker and add a good grinding of black pepper and 1 tsp salt. Stir well, then cook for 5 hrs.
Remove the lid, turn the slow cooker to high and cook for a further 1 hr to reduce the liquid slightly. Taste for seasoning and serve in a warmed bowl.
